name: solokit
description: Runs a solo agent-coding project from idea to release: kickoff, PRD, GitHub repo and rules, issue-driven building, change flow, release and retro.

default_owner.title: Default GitHub owner
default_owner.description: User or organisation that new repos are created under; asked on the first bootstrap when empty.

default_visibility.title: Default repo visibility
default_visibility.description: Visibility preselected when bootstrap creates a repo.

language.title: Project document language
language.description: Language for repo documents in new projects, as a language code such as en.

kit_repo.title: Kit repository
kit_repo.description: owner/name of the solokit repo where retros open kit-improvement issues.

hide_ai_attribution.title: Hide AI attribution
hide_ai_attribution.description: Keep CLAUDE.md local, turn off attribution settings and block attribution in commits, PRs, issues and branch names.

action_band.title: Action band
action_band.description: Show the action band above the prompt in solokit projects.
